items.name: PAY Regression Suite
items.description: Regression test suite for the MFS Payment Gateway modernization project. Covers tokenization, retry handling, and multi-currency functionality.

items.name: PCI Compliance Suite
items.description: PCI DSS v4.0 compliance test suite covering encryption at rest, HSM key management, and cardholder data protection for the MFS token vault.

items.name: Payment tokenization happy path
items.description: Verify that a valid cardholder PAN is correctly tokenized and stored in mfs_payments_db. Token must be irreversible and PCI DSS v4.0 compliant.

test_steps.description: Send POST /api/v2/tokens with valid PAN 4111111111111111
test_steps.expected_result: Response 201 with token_id starting with 'tok_mfs_'

test_steps.description: Verify token_id format matches PCI DSS v4.0 token specification
test_steps.expected_result: Token format is valid and irreversible

test_steps.description: Query mfs_payments_db.card_tokens table for the generated token
test_steps.expected_result: Token record exists with encrypted PAN and correct last_four='1111'

test_steps.description: Send GET /api/v2/tokens/{token_id}
test_steps.expected_result: Response 200 with token metadata, no raw PAN in response

test_steps.description: Verify token_audit_log entry was created
test_steps.expected_result: Audit log contains tokenization event with timestamp and svc-token-vault identity

test_steps.description: Send POST /api/v2/payments with the generated token_id
test_steps.expected_result: Payment processes successfully using the token

test_steps.description: Verify tokenization latency from response headers
test_steps.expected_result: X-Tokenization-Time header shows < 50ms

items.name: Tokenization error handling
items.description: Verify tokenization service correctly handles invalid input: malformed PANs, expired cards, and unsupported card brands.

test_steps.description: Send POST /api/v2/tokens with malformed PAN '12345'
test_steps.expected_result: Response 400 with error code PAY-001 'Invalid token'

test_steps.description: Send POST /api/v2/tokens with PAN failing Luhn check
test_steps.expected_result: Response 400 with Luhn validation error

test_steps.description: Send POST /api/v2/tokens with expired card (expiry_month=01, expiry_year=2020)
test_steps.expected_result: Response 400 with card expired error

test_steps.description: Verify no token records created in mfs_payments_db for invalid inputs
test_steps.expected_result: No new rows in card_tokens table

test_steps.description: Verify error events logged in token_audit_log
test_steps.expected_result: Audit log contains error events with appropriate error codes

items.name: Retry handler with circuit breaker
items.description: Verify the idempotent retry handler correctly retries failed payments with exponential backoff and the circuit breaker opens after threshold failures.

test_steps.description: Submit payment that will fail on first attempt (simulate gateway timeout)
test_steps.expected_result: Payment recorded as failed, retry scheduled

test_steps.description: Verify retry with same idempotency_key does not create duplicate charge
test_steps.expected_result: Same payment_id returned, no duplicate in gateway_ledger

test_steps.description: Verify exponential backoff timing (1s, 2s, 4s)
test_steps.expected_result: Retry intervals match configured backoff schedule

test_steps.description: Submit 5 consecutive failing payments to trigger circuit breaker
test_steps.expected_result: Circuit breaker transitions to OPEN state after 5th failure

test_steps.description: Submit payment while circuit breaker is OPEN
test_steps.expected_result: Immediate rejection with error code PAY-005

test_steps.description: Wait 30 seconds and verify HALF_OPEN probe
test_steps.expected_result: Circuit breaker allows one probe request through

items.name: Multi-currency conversion
items.description: Verify multi-currency payment processing with real-time FX rate conversion for all supported currency pairs.

test_steps.description: GET /api/v2/currencies/rates and verify all 7 currencies returned
test_steps.expected_result: Rates returned for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF

test_steps.description: Submit EUR to USD payment conversion of 100.00 EUR
test_steps.expected_result: Payment processed with converted USD amount

test_steps.description: Verify conversion accuracy within 0.01% of reference rate
test_steps.expected_result: Converted amount matches expected value within tolerance

test_steps.description: Verify conversion_audit record in mfs_audit_db
test_steps.expected_result: Audit record with source_currency, target_currency, rate, and amounts

test_steps.description: Submit payment with unsupported currency (BTC)
test_steps.expected_result: Response 400 with error code PAY-003

test_steps.description: Simulate FX rate provider outage
test_steps.expected_result: System falls back to last known good rate

test_steps.description: Verify fallback rate age is within acceptable window (< 5 minutes)
test_steps.expected_result: Fallback rate used with warning in response headers

test_steps.description: Verify settlement in original currency option
test_steps.expected_result: Settlement record reflects original EUR amount when opted

items.name: Cardholder data encryption verification
items.description: Verify that all cardholder data (PAN, CVV, expiry) is encrypted at rest in mfs_payments_db using AES-256-GCM via HSM-managed keys.

test_steps.description: Insert cardholder data via API and query raw database column values
test_steps.expected_result: Raw column values are ciphertext, not readable PAN/CVV

test_steps.description: Verify encryption algorithm is AES-256-GCM by checking pgcrypto metadata
test_steps.expected_result: Encryption metadata confirms AES-256-GCM

test_steps.description: Verify decryption requires HSM key via svc-token-vault on mfs-vault-pod-01
test_steps.expected_result: Decryption succeeds only with valid HSM session

test_steps.description: Verify decryption audit log entry in mfs_audit_db
test_steps.expected_result: Audit record with timestamp, user, and operation type

test_steps.description: Verify decryption latency < 10ms
test_steps.expected_result: Average decryption time under 10ms across 100 operations

items.name: HSM key rotation without downtime
items.description: Verify that HSM encryption key rotation completes without service downtime and all existing data is re-encrypted with the new key.

test_steps.description: Trigger key rotation via KeyRotationScheduler on mfs-vault-pod-01
test_steps.expected_result: New key generated in HSM, dual-key mode enabled

test_steps.description: Verify existing data is readable during rotation (dual-key read)
test_steps.expected_result: All existing cardholder records decrypt successfully during rotation

test_steps.description: Verify new data is encrypted with new key
test_steps.expected_result: New records use new key ID in encryption metadata

test_steps.description: Verify re-encryption batch completes for all existing records
test_steps.expected_result: All records re-encrypted with new key, old key references cleared

items.name: Settlement batch end-to-end
items.description: End-to-end test for the settlement batch processor: transaction aggregation, ISO 8583 file generation, submission, and confirmation.

test_steps.description: Create 1000 test payment transactions in gateway_ledger
test_steps.expected_result: 1000 COMPLETED transactions in mfs_payments_db.gateway_ledger

test_steps.description: Trigger settlement batch via POST /api/v2/settlements/batch
test_steps.expected_result: Batch created with status PENDING, batch_id returned

test_steps.description: Verify BatchAggregator groups transactions by merchant and currency
test_steps.expected_result: Correct aggregation groupings in settlement_batches table

test_steps.description: Verify ISO 8583 settlement file generated
test_steps.expected_result: Valid ISO 8583 file with correct transaction count and totals

test_steps.description: Verify SFTP transmission to acquirer endpoint
test_steps.expected_result: File successfully uploaded to acquirer SFTP

test_steps.description: Simulate acquirer confirmation response
test_steps.expected_result: Batch status transitions to CONFIRMED

test_steps.description: Verify settlement_records created for each transaction
test_steps.expected_result: 1000 settlement records with correct amounts and statuses

test_steps.description: Verify batch completion within 5-minute SLA
test_steps.expected_result: Total batch processing time < 300 seconds

test_steps.description: Verify state machine transitions logged
test_steps.expected_result: PENDING -> AGGREGATING -> GENERATING -> SUBMITTED -> CONFIRMED all logged

items.name: Balance reconciliation accuracy
items.description: Verify balance reconciliation engine correctly matches gateway ledger entries against settlement records and flags discrepancies.

test_steps.description: Create matching gateway ledger and settlement records for 500 transactions
test_steps.expected_result: 500 matched pairs in test data

test_steps.description: Introduce 5 discrepant records (amount mismatches > $0.01)
test_steps.expected_result: 5 known discrepancies seeded

test_steps.description: Trigger reconciliation via settlement batch completion event
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation engine processes all records

test_steps.description: Verify 495 records marked as matched
test_steps.expected_result: 495 MATCHED records in reconciliation_results table

test_steps.description: Verify 5 records flagged as discrepant
test_steps.expected_result: 5 DISCREPANT records with correct discrepancy amounts

test_steps.description: Verify discrepancy alert sent via svc-notification-svc
test_steps.expected_result: Alert notification delivered with discrepancy summary
